faq.q: Who is Lucia Caminos in GTA 6?
faq.a: Lucia Caminos is one of the two central playable characters in Grand Theft Auto VI. She was taught to fight by her father and was later imprisoned at Leonida Penitentiary for protecting her family.

faq.q: Why was Lucia Caminos in prison?
faq.a: Rockstar says her efforts to protect her family eventually led to her imprisonment at Leonida Penitentiary, and she was released through what the official biography calls sheer luck.

faq.q: What does Lucia Caminos want in GTA 6?
faq.a: She wants the better life her mother has dreamed of since the family's time in Liberty City, and she intends to act directly and make strategic choices rather than wait.

faq.q: How is Lucia Caminos connected to Jason Duval?
faq.a: Their meeting may provide a path toward the life she wants, and the relationship is described as central to the game's published story premise.

faq.q: What crime originally led Lucia's family to trouble?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said in detail. The official material only states that Lucia's efforts to protect her family led to her imprisonment, without naming the specific crime or circumstances.
